title: Correct transmission current
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates transmission line current using P = UI for both voltage scenarios.

title: Power loss calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly computes power loss in part (1) using P_loss = I²R, obtaining approximately 16.6 kW.

title: Voltage drop recognition
description: Important: Student accounts for voltage drop along transmission line before transformer step-down in part (2).

title: Transformer ratio application
description: Important: Student correctly applies transformer turns ratio to calculate final user voltage in part (2).

title: Final user voltage
description: Essential: Student obtains correct final user voltage of approximately 226.2 V in part (2).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student maintains consistent units (kW, V, Ω) throughout calculations.

title: Confusing power types
description: Pitfall: Student confuses transmitted power with power loss or uses incorrect current value in loss formula.

title: Ignoring voltage drop
description: Pitfall: Student applies transformer ratio directly to 5000V without subtracting transmission line voltage drop.
